description: A client's non-ARQ U_PDU goes out in a type 7 D_PDU, and the peer's reply comes back as an S_UNIDATA_INDICATION to the client bound to the destination SAP.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). At 0 conn 1 sends an S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0, SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3, TTL 0 so TTD = 1296000000 ms, U_PDU "ping", no confirmation). Contention: LBT 30000 (DCD-determined idle, K-0070), slot 15, 45000 ms. At 75000 the type 7 goes out: 0.0.1.2 to 0.0.1.3, address size 4, EOW 0, C_PDU ID 0, DATA C_PDU holding the DATA S_PDU SAP 5 to SAP 9 with its TTD, EOT and reception window 10 (one block, duration 5550). At 90000 a burst from 0.0.1.3: at 91000 a single-segment type 7 to 0.0.1.2 (C_PDU ID 0, EOT 10, window 0, DATA S_PDU priority 0, SAP 9 to SAP 5, no TTD, U_PDU "pong"). It is delivered (C-0585, B-0298, A-0233) with S_UNIDATA_INDICATION to conn 1: priority 0, SAP 5, destination 0.0.1.2, tx mode 2, source SAP 9, source 0.0.1.3, U_PDU "pong" (A-0116 to A-0123, A-0236). Nothing is queued at the burst end. Since corpus 0.7.0 the DTS also keeps dts.ttd at the earliest TTD in its transmit queue: started when a request becomes the earliest, cancelled when the transmit queue empties (C-1050).
